offers_products.reason: Sells nutrigenomic supplements like Protandim, skin care and wellness products through its direct-selling network.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from supplements and personal care products; no main service offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Independent distributors and customers buy supplements and skin care for personal use through direct selling.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to individual consumers and independent distributors, not businesses, institutions or government.

recurring_revenue.reason: Monthly auto-ship (subscription-style) orders of supplements by repeat customers and distributors drive most sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Discretionary wellness supplements and skin care can be cut or paused by households in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Supplements and skin care are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for packaged supplement and wellness products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual consumers and independent distributors, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Outsources manufacturing and sells via direct-selling network; no heavy plants or fleets required.
